$description: Design tokens extracted from the claude.ai/design project 'Patterson Academy' (Claude Code Academy). W3C Design Tokens Community Group format (draft). Every token carries an $extensions.com.patterson.source naming the file it was extracted from. Where an extracted value conflicts with the 2025 Brand Guide, the Brand Guide value is in $value and the project's value is recorded in $extensions.com.patterson.conflict. Nothing is invented; gaps are recorded in _tbd and in DESIGN.md section 5.

com.patterson.meta.authoritativeSource: Patterson Companies Brand Guide, VERSION 3.2025 (2025-04-08), as encoded in patterson-corp/plugins/patterson-brand/skills/design-tokens/assets/tokens.json
com.patterson.meta.incubation: This extraction lives in patterson-labs as a recorded default, not a settled decision. Whether this design project or the existing patterson-brand design system supersedes the other is unresolved and escalated; see _SOURCES.md.

sourceKeys.ACADAPP: Patterson Academy handoff export, top-level canvases (Claude Code Academy.dc.html, Lesson Plan.dc.html, Lab Worksheet.dc.html) and support.js
sourceKeys.BG25: Patterson Companies Brand Guide, VERSION 3.2025 - authoritative
sourceKeys.DS20: DesignSystem_042120.pdf - UX design system and governance, April 2020
sourceKeys.DPL: Patterson Digital Pattern Library v5.7.2 toolkit.css - production stylesheet
sourceKeys.CORP: patterson-corp/plugins/patterson-brand/skills/design-tokens - the reference extraction these values are reconciled against

color.$description: The project's palette, reconciled against BG25. The eleven brand hexes below are byte-identical between the project snapshot and BG25 p.24 - the import introduces no new brand colour.

brand.$description: Primary, secondary and tertiary brand palette. The project's tokens/colors.css reproduces BG25 p.24 exactly, PMS annotations included. No reconciliation was needed.

navy.$description: Primary. Headlines, brand accents, dark grounds. The project comments it 'clear thought, trust'.

sky.$description: Primary. Accent, focus ring and emphasis. BG25 p.57 also makes it the default button fill; the project does not - see color.interaction.

gray.$description: Primary. 80% black. Body copy. The project aliases it as the mid-step of its own neutral ramp (--pat-gray-600).

blue.$description: Secondary. The project's link colour and its informational status hue.

grayLight.$description: Secondary. The project aliases it as the 100 step of its neutral ramp.

teal.$description: Tertiary. The project also uses it as its success hue - see color.status.success.

purple.$description: Tertiary. The project uses the BG25 spelling, not the DS20/DPL variant that differs by one digit.

tint.$description: CONFLICT, resolved for BG25. BG25 p.24 publishes a three-step 75/50/25 tint ramp over white; the values below are CORP's sampling of that ramp and are what ships. The project instead defines a five-step 80/60/40/20/10 ramp, for navy and sky only. Both are consistent mixes over white at different stops, so no value is wrong - but the step set is a brand decision and BG25 owns it. The project ramp is recorded here and in DESIGN.md section 2, not shipped.

$extensions.com.patterson.conflict: ACAD tokens/colors.css ships navy 80/60/40/20/10 = #335f85 / #6687a4 / #99afc2 / #ccd7e1 / #e5ebf0 and sky 80/60/40/20/10 = #33b9e7 / #66caed / #99dcf3 / #ccedf9 / #e5f6fc. Superseded by the BG25 ramp.

neutral.$description: The project's cool-gray ramp. BG25 publishes only two greys (#58585B body copy, #ECECEC accent); the intermediate steps are the project's own and are carried through. [TBD: not specified in BG25.]

ink.$description: Near-black. The project wires this to --text-heading. NOT shipped as the heading colour: BG25 and DPL set every heading level in navy, and the sibling lab-workshop snapshot corrects this to navy itself. Retained as a token because the project defines it; see color.text.heading.

$extensions.com.patterson.conflict: used as --text-heading in ACAD tokens/base.css; superseded by navy

gray600.$description: The project's ramp step 600 is the BG25 body-copy grey exactly.

gray100.$description: The project's ramp step 100 is the BG25 accent grey exactly.

status.$description: CONFLICT, resolved for the documented Patterson implementation. BG25 publishes no status colours at all; DS20 p.37 names four states without hexes; DPL ships the hexes CORP carries. The project harmonised its own error and warning hues to the brand palette instead. Those two harmonised values are superseded here - a design project does not get to redefine the alert palette - and are recorded in DESIGN.md section 2 and _SOURCES.md. The project's success and info choices are its own and are noted per token.

error.$description: Error message boxes, error text, invalid field borders.

$extensions.com.patterson.conflict: ACAD --pat-danger is a palette-harmonised brick red; superseded

$extensions.com.patterson.source: DS20 p.8 accent green, DPL, via CORP
$extensions.com.patterson.conflict: ACAD --pat-success is #00817D (BG25 tertiary teal); superseded, but note the project's choice is a published BG25 colour and DS20 does not name a success hex
ACAD --pat-warning is a palette-harmonised amber; superseded

urgent.$description: Urgent message box: navy fill, white text. The project defines no urgent state.

info.$description: Informational state. The project's own, and it resolves to a published BG25 secondary colour. [TBD: no informational state is published in BG25 or given a hex in DS20.]

statusSurface.$description: The tinted grounds the project pairs with its status hues. Carried because BG25 and DS20 publish no status surfaces whatsoever, so these are the only extracted values. [TBD: not specified in BG25.] Note that warningSurface and errorSurface were mixed from the project's own harmonised hues, which color.status supersedes - they therefore pair loosely, not exactly, with the hexes shipped above.

text.$description: The project's text aliases (tokens/colors.css 'SEMANTIC ALIASES'), reconciled.

heading.$description: CONFLICT, resolved for BG25. The project points --text-heading at its near-black ink. Every Patterson source sets headings in navy: BG25 p.24 designates navy for headlines, DPL sets .rtf h1/h2/h3 to #003767, and the lab-workshop snapshot of this same design system corrects the value to navy in its own base.css.

$extensions.com.patterson.source: ACAD --text-body; = BG25 p.24 body copy grey

link.$description: The project's link colour is BG25's published secondary blue. Kept: BG25 is silent on link colour, and where a published brand colour meets an unpublished one, the brand colour wins. DS20 p.8 specifies #147CBD for links on light grounds for WCAG 2.0 contrast; the two differ only in the green channel. See DESIGN.md section 2.

$extensions.com.patterson.alternative: DS20 p.8 link blue #147CBD, shipped by DPL

border.$description: The project's border aliases, drawn from its own neutral ramp. [TBD: BG25 publishes no border colours; DPL ships #D8D8D8 for rules and #A8A9AC for field borders.]

$extensions.com.patterson.alternative: DPL rule #D8D8D8, field border #A8A9AC via CORP

buttonPrimary.$description: BG25 p.57: 'Default color: Sky blue'. The project's snapshot defines no button intent tokens at all - the sibling lab-workshop snapshot does, and ships navy. See that skill's DESIGN.md for the conflict.

overlay.$description: Scrim over imagery. A navy at 55% alpha - the brand navy, so no reconciliation was needed.

brand.$description: CONFLICT, resolved for BG25. BG25 p.25 names Proxima Nova with Arial as the sanctioned fallback, and DPL ships exactly this stack. The project inserts a free web font between the two as a rendering fallback and self-hosts Proxima Nova binaries. Both are superseded: CORP records the substitute family as a wrong earlier extraction that appears in no Patterson source, and the binaries are unlicensed for self-hosting. Reference the Adobe Fonts kit; ship nothing.

$extensions.com.patterson.conflict: ACAD tokens/typography.css --font-sans inserts a free Google fallback family after proxima-nova and before the system stack; ACAD tokens/fonts.css self-hosts three Proxima Nova woff2 faces and imports the fallback from fonts.googleapis.com

display.$description: The project sets --font-display to the same stack as --font-sans. One family carries the whole system, exactly as BG25 p.25 requires.

mono.$description: The project's monospace stack, used for code samples in the Academy canvases. [TBD: not specified in BG25 - Patterson publishes no monospace face.]

weight.$description: The project declares seven numeric weights. BG25 p.25/p.27 names five by role: Light, Regular, Semibold, Bold, Extrabold. Medium 500 and Black 900 are the project's own additions. [TBD for those two: no BG25 counterpart.]

size.$description: The project's type scale is FLUID: seven of its eleven steps are CSS clamp() expressions that interpolate on viewport width, which no Patterson source publishes. Carried verbatim as strings because a clamp() is not a DTCG dimension. [TBD: BG25 specifies type relationally (leading and tracking as ratios of size) and DPL ships a fixed pixel scale; neither publishes a fluid scale.] The fixed steps are given in rem at a 16px root.

h1.$description: 36px to 52px. The floor equals DPL's fixed 36px h1.

body.$description: 16px. CONFLICT with DPL's shipped 18px body; recorded in DESIGN.md section 3. BG25 states no absolute body size, so this is a production divergence, not a brand violation.

stat.$description: 40px to 64px. The oversized sky numeral is a signature device of this system.

lineHeight.$description: Five named ratios. The body ratio 1.6 sits inside BG25 p.27's published 125-150% band only if read loosely - it is 160%, ten points above the band's ceiling. Recorded as a conflict in DESIGN.md section 3 rather than silently corrected, because BG25's band is stated for print body copy.

$extensions.com.patterson.conflict: BG25 p.27 body leading band is 125-150% of size; CORP ships 1.5

tracking.$description: The project's five tracking steps. --ls-snug is BG25 p.27's tracking -10 exactly, and --ls-tight is close to its large-scale -25. --ls-caps 0.08em exists only to letterspace uppercase labels, which BG25 p.25 forbids in digital channels; it is carried as a token but is not applied by the base layer. See DESIGN.md section 3.

$extensions.com.patterson.conflict: supports an all-caps treatment BG25 p.25 rejects for digital

case.$description: BG25 p.25: 'All caps are to be avoided in any digital channel since this is regarded as shouting.' BG25 p.59 puts titles, headlines, subheads, text and captions all in sentence case. The project's eyebrow is the one surface that breaks this.

eyebrow.$description: CONFLICT, resolved for BG25. The project sets .pat-eyebrow to text-transform: uppercase with 0.08em tracking. DS20 p.10 and p.16 both put eyebrows in sentence case, and the lab-workshop snapshot of this same system corrects its default eyebrow to sentence case. Shipped as sentence case; the uppercase treatment is preserved as an opt-in class in theme.css.

spacing.$description: CONFLICT, resolved for BG25. The project is built on a 4px base unit; Patterson digital work sits on a 5px grid, which is where BG25 p.57's explicit 30px button padding lands and which CORP ships as Tailwind's base unit. 30px is not expressible on a 4px grid at all. The BG25 grid is what --spacing carries; the project's own thirteen-step scale is carried alongside under dimension.spacingImported so nothing is lost.

$extensions.com.patterson.conflict: ACAD tokens/spacing.css declares a 4px base unit

spacingImported.$description: The project's own named spacing scale, 4px base. Carried verbatim, namespaced so it cannot be mistaken for the BG25 grid. [TBD: no Patterson source publishes a named spacing scale.]

radius.$description: CONFLICT, resolved for BG25. BG25 p.57 states 'Rounded corners: 5px radius', and 5px is the dominant DPL value. The project ships a seven-step ramp whose steps are 2/4/6/10/16/24px plus a 999px pill; none of them is 5px. The BG25 radius is the default; the project ramp is carried under dimension.radiusImported.

radiusImported.$description: The project's corner ramp, carried verbatim. [TBD: BG25 publishes one radius, not a ramp.] The pill step in particular has no Patterson counterpart - the sibling lab-workshop snapshot annotates it as a system convention with no production equivalent.

control.$description: Control sizing. The button height is a conflict resolved for BG25; the project's three-step control ramp is carried alongside.

buttonHeight.$description: BG25 p.57. The project's default control height is 44px, chosen as a hit-target floor rather than from a Patterson source.

buttonPaddingX.$description: Width = type width + 30px padding left and right.

heightMd.$description: The project's default; documented as a minimum hit target.

layout.$description: Container widths. [TBD: the project's 1240px wrapper and DPL's 1300px wrapper are both production values from different implementations; BG25 publishes no page width, so neither supersedes the other. The project value is carried and the DPL value recorded.]

$extensions.com.patterson.alternative: DPL page wrapper max-width 1300px via CORP

gutter.$description: The container gutter is a fluid clamp(), carried verbatim as a string for the same reason as font.size.

effect.$description: Elevation, rings, motion and blur. NONE of this group has a Brand Guide counterpart: BG25 and DS20 publish no elevation scale, no focus style and no motion tokens, and CORP reads the brand as flat - its only documented shadow is a barely-visible inset on text inputs. This group is therefore carried whole as project-originated, marked [TBD], and is the largest single piece of new information the import contributes. It is also the clearest candidate for the supersession ruling: a flat brand and a five-step elevation ramp cannot both be right.

shadow.$description: Five steps, all tinted with the brand navy at low alpha rather than neutral black.

ring.$description: Focus and error rings. The focus ring is the brand sky at 45% alpha, carried verbatim. The error ring is RE-DERIVED from the error colour this extraction ships (#D0021B at 35% alpha); the project's own error ring was mixed from the harmonised red that color.status supersedes, and carrying it would have reintroduced a rejected value in decimal form.

$extensions.com.patterson.conflict: ACAD --ring-error was mixed from its superseded brick red

easing.$description: Two easings. DPL's only documented transition is 'background-color .3s ease-out, color .3s ease-out' on .button, which the 320ms slow step and the ease-out curve are compatible with.

panel.$description: Optional panel treatment on sticky headers.

duration.$description: Three motion steps. [TBD: no Patterson source publishes duration tokens.]

_tbd.$description: Recorded gaps. Do not fill these in without a source. Full reasoning: DESIGN.md section 5.
_tbd.supersessionRuling: [TBD: whether this design project or the existing patterson-brand design system is authoritative is unresolved. This extraction incubates in patterson-labs pending that ruling and asserts nothing about it.]
_tbd.elevationScale: [TBD: BG25 and DS20 publish no elevation scale. The five-step navy-tinted ramp in effect.shadow is the project's own and directly contradicts CORP's reading of the brand as flat.]
_tbd.focusStyle: [TBD: no Patterson source publishes a focus treatment. The 3px sky ring is the project's own accessibility addition.]
_tbd.motionTokens: [TBD: no Patterson source publishes easing or duration tokens beyond DPL's single .button transition.]
_tbd.fluidTypeScale: [TBD: no Patterson source publishes a viewport-interpolated type scale. Seven of the project's eleven steps are clamp() expressions.]
_tbd.monospaceFace: [TBD: Patterson publishes no monospace typeface. The project's choice is its own.]
_tbd.namedSpacingScale: [TBD: no Patterson source publishes a named spacing scale. The project's 4px scale and CORP's inferred 5px grid are both reconstructions, which is why the conflict is recorded rather than declared settled.]
_tbd.pageWidth: [TBD: BG25 publishes no page width. The project ships 1240px and DPL ships 1300px.]
_tbd.statusColoursInBrandGuide: [TBD: no status colours appear in BG25. Both the project's harmonised set and the DPL set shipped here are implementation values.]
_tbd.informationalState: [TBD: DS20 p.37 names four message states - Positive, Error, Neutral, Urgent - and no informational state. The project's info hue has no brand counterpart.]
_tbd.selfHostedProximaNova: [TBD: the snapshot's tokens/fonts.css self-hosts three Proxima Nova woff2 faces and describes them as licensed binaries supplied by the brand team. Whether the Patterson licence permits self-hosting is unconfirmed; CORP's position is that Adobe's terms forbid re-hosting Typekit payloads. No binary is shipped here and the font directory in the export is empty.]
_tbd.brandGuidePdfUnread: [TBD: the design project's own readme records that the Brand Guide PDF exceeded 30 MB and could not be read inside the project - its colour tokens were built from a single palette-page image. Sections of that guide the project therefore inferred from websites are not independently verifiable from this snapshot.]
